description: cilium-operator ENI IPAM: IP pool, EC2 API, DaemonSet health. Scraped from jobs cilium-operator (:9963) and kube-state-metrics. Empty on a Flannel cluster.

panels.title: Operator Up
panels.description: Scrape status of cilium-operator (:9963). The legend shows the operator pod name.

panels.title: Operator Version
panels.description: Operator version from cilium_operator_version.

panels.title: Cilium DaemonSet
panels.description: Ready vs desired pods of the cilium DaemonSet (kube-state-metrics).

panels.title: IPs Needed
panels.description: cilium_operator_ipam_ips{type="needed"}. Above 0 means a node is waiting on the EC2 API for ENI IPs. Red when nonzero.

panels.title: Cilium and Hubble Pods by Phase
panels.description: kube-system pods named cilium* or hubble* by phase (kube_pod_status_phase).

panels.title: Nodes by IPAM Category
panels.description: cilium_operator_ipam_nodes: total nodes, nodes in IP deficit, nodes at ENI capacity.

panels.title: IPAM IPs (available / used / needed)
panels.description: cilium_operator_ipam_ips by type across all nodes. needed (red) above 0 means allocation is lagging.

panels.title: Needed IPs by Node
panels.description: cilium_operator_ipam_needed_ips per node. The red line marks 1; any point above it is a node waiting for IPs.

panels.title: Used IPs by Node
panels.description: cilium_operator_ipam_used_ips per node.

panels.title: Available IPs by Node
panels.description: cilium_operator_ipam_available_ips per node (free ENI secondary IPs).

panels.title: Available IPs per Subnet
panels.description: Free addresses in each VPC subnet the operator can allocate from.

panels.title: IP Allocation Ops by Subnet
panels.description: Rate of ENI secondary IP allocations per subnet (cilium_operator_ipam_ip_allocation_ops_total).

panels.title: Interface Creation Ops by Subnet
panels.description: Rate of ENI creations per subnet (cilium_operator_ipam_interface_creation_ops_total).

panels.title: Available Interfaces
panels.description: ENIs the operator can still attach across all nodes (cilium_operator_ipam_available_interfaces).

panels.title: Empty Interface Slots
panels.description: Free ENI attachment slots across all nodes (cilium_operator_ipam_empty_interface_slots).

panels.title: Resyncs Queued
panels.description: Rate of IPAM resync operations queued (cilium_operator_ipam_resync_queued_total).

panels.title: EC2 API Calls by Operation and Response
panels.description: EC2 API call rate by operation and response code (cilium_operator_ec2_api_duration_seconds_count). Any response_code other than OK is a failed call.

panels.title: EC2 API Duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 EC2 API call duration per operation (cilium_operator_ec2_api_duration_seconds).

panels.title: Operator Errors and Warnings
panels.description: Rate of operator log errors and warnings (cilium_operator_errors_warnings_total).

panels.title: IP Allocation Duration (mean since operator start)
panels.description: Mean time to satisfy an IP allocation request since the operator started (cilium_operator_ipam_allocation_duration_seconds_sum / _count). Allocations are rare, so a rate-based quantile returns nothing most of the time.
